title: With weak signal, Pay for this order says the gym has no online payment
what: Every failure of the payment calls (no internet, a timeout, a server error) is swallowed and read as 'nothing', with no note kept in the released app. The order's pay button then says online payment is not set up at this gym yet and to pay at the desk, even at a gym that has it switched on.
expected: A member with no signal is told to try again, the real cause is noted for support, and the 'not set up' words show only when the gym really has no online payment.
how_often: each time the pay button is tapped with weak signal or the server fails
fix_line: Tell 'could not reach' apart from 'not switched on', show a try-again line for the first, and note the error

title: Eleven gym helpers, including paying the gym and saving the push address, have no test at all
what: No unit test or phone test loads the helpers that call the payment server, save and clear the phone's push address with the gym, keep My membership for no-signal days, sync gym chat, gym hours, machine busy times and gym mates, run the 15-minute message check, pick the shop's bag, or keep the leaderboard and mates live.
expected: Each helper that sends data to the gym or handles money has at least one test of its main rule and its failure path.
how_often: any change to these parts ships unchecked
fix_line: Add small tests for the pay calls, push address, kept membership and the sync helpers

title: Some gym tests wait a fixed 20 ms or read today's real date, so they can fail on a slow runner or at midnight
what: The home-screen logo tests wait a fixed 20 thousandths of a second for the background work and then check it happened, which a busy test machine can miss. Two other tests compare against today's real date taken at a different moment from the code's, so a run that crosses midnight fails.
expected: Tests wait until the result is there, and fix the clock to a set day.
how_often: now and then, on slow or late-night runs
fix_line: Wait for the result instead of a fixed pause, and set a fake clock
